core_obligations: (1),(2)=>(3) by the Noetherian companion lemma; the observation that (3) passes to A^1 x f is quoted from the companion's proof.

Main direction (3)=>closed: assume y in closure(f(Z)) \ E; Chevalley makes E constructible; Jacobson punctured spectrum gives t in E with t leadsto y; a closed point x of the fibre Z_t (Nullstellensatz finiteness) seeds the construction.

Normalization: C -> T the normalization of T in kappa(x), finite by the Nagata property; c over y closed with dim O_{C,c} = 1; the rational map C --> X has a representative U, trimmed to C = U amalg {c} so the diagram fits (3).
Contradiction: the dotted arrow extends the rational map to c; its image lands in Z over y, contradicting y not in E.
proof_roadmap: Set up the boundary point with Chevalley + Jacobson.
Dotted arrow extends the rational map; contradiction.
difficulty_reason: Chevalley constructibility + Jacobson closed points + Nagata normalization finiteness + rational map representative; the contradiction closes through the glueing-equivalence footnote and the scheme-theoretic image.

compared.difference: The separation counterpart (at most one dotted arrow) is delivered separately; this lemma is the existence (universal closedness) half.
